training_data.name: verified teacher traces on MedQA-USMLE questions
training_data.quote: 40,853 verified teacher traces on MedQA-USMLE training questions in 4-option (20,360) and 5-option (20,493) form (15,427 prompt variants), 8-gram decontaminated against the evaluation sets. Trace teacher: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, 8 samples per question at temperature 1.0, keep the correct ones (up to 3, shortest first).

training_method.objective_quote: further fine-tuned (supervised) on verified long-chain-of-thought answers. recipe: SFT, 4 epochs, LR 1e-5 (5% warmup), max length 8,192, flatten packing, bf16 + ZeRO-2; final checkpoint (step 3,368).

description.text: `Qwen3-4B-OT3-medical` is the medical domain teacher of the MMOPD study: `MMOPD/Qwen3-4B-OT3-2ep` further fine-tuned (supervised) on verified long-chain-of-thought answers that a much stronger model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MedQA 94.6%) produced for MedQA training questions. Only traces whose final answer matched the gold letter were kept (rejection sampling), at most 3 distinct traces per question. It raises MedQA from 69.8 to 80.7 while keeping the general Qwen3 thinking format.

verified long-chain-of-thought answers that a much stronger model produced for MedQA training questions. Eval only: MedQA 80.7, MedXpertQA 22.3, PubMedQA 77.2.

serving.text_only_input_quote: A 45-year-old man presents with sudden severe chest pain radiating to the back and a blood pressure difference between arms. What is the most likely diagnosis?
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets do_sample, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, and top_k 20. The card example adds max_new_tokens=32768. Domain-benchmark scores use temperature 1.0 and top_p 1.0. The vLLM line sets --max-model-len 40960, which is larger than config.json max_position_embeddings 32768. Training max length is 8,192. The chat template adds a system turn only when the user supplies one or when tools are passed. No adapter file is in the repo. Hub safetensors lists BF16 4411424256 and total 4022468096, with tie_word_embeddings true. No paper or GitHub repository names this checkpoint.

evaluation_reported.text: Domain accuracy at temperature 1.0: MedQA 80.7, MedXpertQA 22.3, PubMedQA 77.2 (macro-F1 57.4), CaseHOLD 59.8, FinQA 54.0, TAT-QA not reported. The init model scores MedQA 69.8. General benchmarks at the Qwen3 thinking preset: AIME24 52.9, AIME25 45.0, AIME26 40.0, LiveCodeBench v6 39.9, IFEval 41.2, IFBench 27.0.

discrepancies: Method, the named dataset id, and the parent match. The card also trains on 20,493 five-option traces and does not name a second dataset id. The YAML tag list includes distillation; the training recipe line says SFT on teacher traces.
